Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of
right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism and force
of impact are consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination. Over the
course of 25 visits, care progressed along a typical rehabilitation pathway, including
manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home program instruction, with visit
frequency tpaering as symptoms improved and function returned. Orthopedic examination
revealed positive findings on resisted testing and limited active elevation, while
several other provider tests, including neurological screening and stability
assessment, returned normal results. No prior injury or treatment involving the same
shoulder region is documented in the patient history. Billing records reflect single,
appropriately spaced charges for each service with no duplicated entries. At discharge
the patient was improving and was advised to continue the home exercise program as
needed.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
